text:
neal (docs): opened PR #978 that updates the streaming API snippets and adds a short migration note for the streaming response shape. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978/files. Getting a couple CI errors (linkcheck + vale + spellcheck). Can someone help triage?

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · failed
  2 broken links detected:
   - docs/snippets/streaming/python.md: line 18 -> https://old-examples.example.com/streaming (timeout)
   - docs/guides/streaming-migration.md: line 5 -> /guides/nonexistent.md (file missing)
Run `make docs-linkcheck` or see log: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/338201

ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · failed
  Rules triggered: Contractions (1), PassiveVoice (1), Complexity (1)
  Excerpt: "we've updated the shape" -> suggest: "we updated the shape"; "the stream will be terminated" -> suggest active voice

ci-bot: docs-ci/spellcheck · failed
  Noted: lowercase `redwood` in heading, `api` in body — style expects `Redwood` and `API`.

tia (eng-runtime): I can take the broken links. The external example host is flaky; we should mirror the minimal example into `docs/snippets/streaming/examples.md` and point to that. Also will replace the missing relative file with a pointer to the migration doc's section anchor.

neal (docs): good plan. please keep changes focused — no reworking diagrams in this PR.

rob (infra): FYI that external host is behind a CDN we deprecated; i'm ok with mirroring the minimal example. i'll create a tiny redirect if we want, but docs-only copy is simplest.

maria (design): Vale also flagged some long passive sentences in the 'behavior' note. I can rewrite into active voice without changing the steps or examples. Won't touch code blocks.

neal (docs): thanks. while you're at it, please fix `Redwood` capitalization and `API` casing. Small style commit ok.

----
neal (docs): Patch plan:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/978-streaming-fixups
# mirror example from external host into repo
mkdir -p docs/snippets/streaming
curl -sS https://old-examples.example.com/streaming/minimal.py -o docs/snippets/streaming/examples.md || true
# replace link targets
rg "https://old-examples.example.com/streaming" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|https://old-examples.example.com/streaming|/snippets/streaming/examples.md|g' {}
rg "/guides/nonexistent.md" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|/guides/nonexistent.md|/guides/streaming-migration.md#compatibility|g' {}
# small style fixes
rg "\bredwood\b" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|redwood|Redwood|g' {}
rg "\bapi\b" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|api|API|g' {}
```

neal (docs): I'll leave the commits separate: link fixes, style fixes, and a final commit with Maria's copy edits. That helps reviewers.

maria (design): Pushed a short copy patch to the branch: changed passive voice in two places, split a long sentence flagged for Complexity. Left one inline suggestion about clarifying "client buffer".

rob (infra): I added a tiny redirect in infra/redirects for the old host so any lingering external links won't 404. Not necessary but low risk.

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · pending
ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · pending
ci-bot: docs-ci/spellcheck · pending

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · success
ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · failed
  Remaining: Contractions (1) in snippets/streaming/python.md — suggestion: expand `we've` to `we have` or rephrase.

neal (docs): Oops — I missed that contraction in an inline comment. I'll update it.

neal (docs): Pushed commit to expand contraction and addressed Maria's inline. Re-running CI.

ci-bot: docs-ci/all · success (8m)

neal (docs): Added `docs/approved` label. @tia @maria please give a final quick look; plan to merge after green.

tia (eng-runtime): LGTM for link changes. Verified the example runs locally.

maria (design): LGTM for copy. Small nit about punctuation in a bullet but not blocking.

neal (docs): Merged PR #978 and backported heading casing fix to main. Thanks everyone — that was fast! :tada:
